pages.text: The desert heat drains your water. A thirst bar appears above hunger.$(br2)When thirst is empty, you take damage!$(br2)Restore thirst by:$(br)- Using a Water Skin$(br)- Eating Lotus Flowers$(br)- Standing in water
Holds 5 drinks. Right-click water to fill. Right-click to drink.$(br2)Bar color shows level:$(br)Blue = Good$(br)Orange = Low$(br)Red = Empty
